review.why: Writes platform-native posts and threads with hooks, a content calendar, a repurposing plan and a daily engagement routine.
review.summary: Collects goals, audience, voice and resources, then gives a platform quick reference, content pillars, hook formulas, a blog-to-social repurposing system, a weekly calendar, engagement routines, metrics and tips for when the user is stuck. Every output starts with the hook and carries confidence tags. Proactive triggers flag copy-pasting one post everywhere.
strengths: Hook first: no body copy without one
Flags unsustainable posting frequency and too much promotion
Adapts length and tone per platform instead of one generic post
cautions: Platform frequencies and growth tips are generic rules of thumb
Covers much the same ground as other social skills, with less depth
Three reference files are not read here
